verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents its own shareable Payment Links that merchants can send over email, SMS and social 'without any need for coding'. However, the evidence never says links are created in the Dashboard, and onboarding is sales-led with no self-serve rate card, so 'start selling immediately' is not supported. Missing for 10: explicit Dashboard link-creation flow, evidence of self-serve instant activation for live selling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: Send secure Payment Links over email, SMS, social, and more – without any need for coding
Accept payments on any channel using shareable payment links.
